name: ash
lore_descriptor: pale, straight-grained; the wood of warriors
first_pickup_chronicle: Ash. Yggdrasil was an ash. So was every Viking spear-shaft. Springy and unsplittable under shock — what hardwood ought to be.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.00, weight_mult 0.90, no effective_against (T2 core wood, reference). Best for polearms and spears (shock-resistant). Mythologically heavy (Yggdrasil) without being mechanically over-tuned.
